name: Bleelblep's Revenge Next Plugins
description: Revenge Next ports of bleelblep/revengeplugins, built from this repository.

bleelblep.ai-core.name: AI Core
bleelblep.ai-core.description: Shared AI plumbing for this repository's plugins. Holds one API key, one daily spending cap and one request queue, so the plugins that use a model do not each ask for their own. Does nothing on its own — install it only if a plugin asks for it.
bleelblep.ai-core.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.catch-up.name: Catch Up
bleelblep.catch-up.description: Summarises what you missed in a channel. Run /catchup and the last few hundred messages come back as a short brief only you can see. Needs AI Core for the key and the spending cap.
bleelblep.catch-up.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.custom-timestamps.name: Custom Timestamps
bleelblep.custom-timestamps.description: Customize the format of timestamps in chat — calendar, relative, ISO 8601, or a custom format string.
bleelblep.custom-timestamps.author: bleelblep, Fiery

bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.name: Ghost Log Native Beta
bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.description: Native-first rewrite beta of Ghost Log. Logs deleted messages with AES-GCM encryption, restores them in chat across reloads, and keeps an encrypted backup. Testing track for the stable plugin.
bleelblep.ghost-log-native-beta.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.name: Hide Call Buttons
bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.description: Hides call and video buttons from DMs, user profiles and voice channels.
bleelblep.hide-call-buttons.author: John (janisslsm), bleelblep

bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.name: Hide Servers
bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.description: Locally hide servers — or entire folders — from your server list. The stock bar does the hiding itself, so folders, unread badges and drag-to-reorder all behave exactly as stock.
bleelblep.hide-servers-drawer.author: bleelblep, blerp

bleelblep.plugin-hub.name: Plugin Hub
bleelblep.plugin-hub.description: Adds a Plugin Hub row under Revenge's Plugins, with shortcuts straight into the settings of the plugins you choose. Show them as favourites and a list, an icon grid, cards or sideways shelves, with bleelblep plugins, bleelblep AI Core and other plugins in their own sections. Adding plugins needs Revenge's Developer Mode switched on; using the hub does not.
bleelblep.plugin-hub.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.name: Screenshot Redactor (Legacy)
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.description: Pre-347 build, kept for Discord versions older than 347 only — install Screenshot Redactor instead. A toggle that replaces usernames and avatars with stable placeholders, so a conversation can be screenshotted without doxxing anyone. The thread still reads in order — the same person keeps the same placeholder.
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor-legacy.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.name: Screenshot Redactor
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.description: A toggle that replaces usernames and avatars with stable placeholders, so a conversation can be screenshotted without doxxing anyone. The thread still reads in order — the same person keeps the same placeholder.
bleelblep.screenshot-redactor.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.second-thoughts.name: Second Thoughts
bleelblep.second-thoughts.description: A send-guard that stays quiet. Credentials, API keys and card numbers are caught by pattern alone -- no key, no network, no AI -- and never reach the wire. Install AI Core as well and it also weighs up anger, drunk-posting and oversharing, but only on a draft a free local check has already flagged. Everything else sends untouched, at full speed.
bleelblep.second-thoughts.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.send-tweaks.name: Send Tweaks
bleelblep.send-tweaks.description: Small fixes to what you send. Removes tracking from links (?si=, utm_source, fbclid and friends), lets replies start without pinging, and applies your own find-and-replace rules. Text inside code blocks is never touched.
bleelblep.send-tweaks.author: bleelblep

bleelblep.show-tag.name: Show Tag
bleelblep.show-tag.description: Shows the username (or full Discord tag on legacy accounts) in the message header, including reply previews.
bleelblep.show-tag.author: Cynosphere, bleelblep

bleelblep.staff-tags.name: Staff Tags
bleelblep.staff-tags.description: Shows extra tags for staff members — OWNER, ADMIN, STAFF, MOD, VC Mod, Chat Mod, WEBHOOK.
bleelblep.staff-tags.author: bleelblep, Fiery

bleelblep.translate.name: Translate
bleelblep.translate.description: Long-press any message to translate it in place, and long-press again to put it back. Optionally translates everything not already in your language as it arrives. Four keyless services behind it — Google, Bing, Yandex and MyMemory — tried in turn, so one going down does not take the plugin with it. No key, no account, no AI.
bleelblep.translate.author: bleelblep
